title: Utility Services Terms: Electric Service Charge on Estimated Electricity Lines for Established Residents
content:
# Electric Service Charge on Estimated Lines — Utility Services Program

**Term.** The electricity service charge on a Utility Services Program estimated electricity line is the monthly fixed electric service charge of the program times a service share, rounded half up to the cent:

1. a share of **0.5** when the Apartment Home Lease's move-in date lies at least 36 whole months before the billing date and no estimated electricity usage line was issued on the account fewer than twelve whole months before it;
2. a share of **0.75** when the move-in date lies at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before the billing date and no such estimated line was issued in those twelve months;
3. the **whole charge** in every other situation.

## Grid

| Whole months since move-in | Estimated electricity line issued in the last twelve months | Service share |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | none | 0.5 |
| 12 to 35 | none | 0.75 |
| fewer than 12 | none | whole |
| any | one or more | whole |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Move-in 2023-05-10, billing date 2026-05-10: 36 whole months, share 0.5 when no estimated electricity line was issued in the twelve months; on 2026-05-09 the tenure is 35 whole months and the share is 0.75.
- Any tenure, with an estimated electricity line issued eight months before the billing date: the whole charge.

*Worked figure (hypothetical monthly charge of $10.00):* 0.5 gives $5.00; 0.75 gives $7.50.
